d:
BJP National President Nitin Nabin has sparked controversy with his remark about Punjab's soldiers and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government. Speaking at a rally in Jalandhar on November 18, he said that if Punjab's soldiers resolve to do so, they could also succeed in removing the AAP government. His statement drew criticism from AAP leaders, Congress and retired military officers, who said the armed forces should not be dragged into politics. The controversy has also raised questions about Election Commission guidelines and the Representation of the People Act, 1951.
